rows.question: Which performance metrics determine executives' annual cash bonus and performance-based equity awards?
rows.answer: For fiscal 2025, BILL's annual cash bonus program (Fiscal 2025 Bonus Program) was based equally on two corporate financial metrics: Core Revenue and EBITDA Less Float, with an individual performance component also considered. Performance-based equity (PSUs) for fiscal 2025 consisted of two types: (1) Financial PSUs, earned based on Core Revenue growth, subject to a cap (100% of target payout) unless a Non-GAAP Operating Income threshold ($190.7 million) was exceeded; and (2) Relative TSR PSUs, earned based on the company's total stockholder return percentile rank relative to the Russell 3000 index over a three-year performance period.
